versions.changelog: Balance and cost questions now answer from a live account read rather than from figures written into the package.

cs-onboard-voice v0.1.1

- New: Skill converts a written customer-onboarding step list into 8–20 spoken audio clips (one per labeled step).
- Supports onboarding audio packs: welcome, identity, documents, first login, and more.
- Enforces collection of only written onboarding steps; does not invent or add steps.
- Handles voice cloning requests with explicit consent and credit confirmation.
- Manages all Beatra API operations via bundled command-line client with secure, controlled execution.
- Includes detailed slot planning, clip delivery, cloning/billing safeguards, and automatic safe updates.
